issue_context.title: fritz.cleanup aborts with error
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The fritz.cleanup service of the fritz integration does not work anymore for me (used to work previously) and just throws and error ID that does not explain what the problem could be.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.12.6

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

fritz

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/fritz/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
alias: Fritz!Box alte Geräte löschen
sequence:
  - service: fritz.cleanup
    data:
      device_id: bafa3d3a6a8ad284743a5730d3ed3365
mode: single
icon: mdi:trash-can
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
When executing this, it just throws the error:

Stopped because an error was encountered at 6. Januar 2022, 09:03:29 (runtime: 2.10 seconds)
'99e4e78c6495cda18151ffaebce55e6b'


I could execute the script successfully in the past, but now it is not working anymore (so probably broken by one of the later updates). 
I have also recreated another one with the fritz.cleanup service, selecting the only available fritz box, to make sure that there was not just any id matching error, but the result remains the same, it just throws and error with an ID that does not tell me anything (and that is different than the device_id from the service call).
```


### Additional information

_No response_

If I run cleanup for a specific device, a second one should not interfere, no matter if active or disabled.
Its a bit confusing since the service UI changed to use the script engine under the hood a few versions ago.
Regardless the fix is merged and will be in 2022.2
